mapper.select: SELECT ib.expected_arrival_date AS expectedArrivalDate, ib.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, poi.supplier_product_id AS supplierProductId, SUM(COALESCE(ibi.qualified_qty, 0)) AS qualifiedQty, SUM(COALESCE(ibi.defective_qty, 0)) AS defectiveQty, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ibi.current_qty, 0) * COALESCE(ibi.unit_price, 0)) / 100 AS UNSIGNED) AS totalAmount FROM inbound_bill ib JOIN inbound_bill_item ibi ON ibi.inbound_bill_id = ib.id LEFT JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.id = ibi.source_item_id WHERE ib.source_party_id = #{supplierId} AND ib.inbound_type = 'PURCHASE_IN' AND ib.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ib.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND ib.confirmed_at >= #{since} AND ib.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ib.id, ib.expected_arrival_date, ib.confirmed_at, poi.supplier_product_id ORDER BY ib.confirmed_at ASC LIMIT 30000
